info.name: Salesforce Get Record Data and Object Metadata

items.docs:
Get layout information, metadata, and data to build UI for a single record or for a collection of records.
The response contains layout information for whichever layout types are specified in the layoutTypes parameter.

It contains data for the records specified in the recordIds parameter.

info.name: Salesforce Get a Directory of Supported Objects

items.docs: Get a Salesforce org’s active theme. A theme uses colors, images, and banners to change the overall appearance of Salesforce. Administrators can define themes and switch themes to provide a different look. The User Interface API response matches the Admin’s selection.
Get metadata about a specific object. The response includes metadata describing fields, child relationships, record type, and theme.

info.name: Salesforce Get Lookup Field Suggestions for a Specified Object

params.name: SOBJECT_API_NAME
params.description: The API name of a source object.

params.name: FIELD_API_NAME
params.description: The API name of a lookup field on the source object.

params.name: TARGET_API_NAME
params.description: The API name of the target (lookup) object.

items.docs: When a user edits a lookup field, use this resource to search for and display suggestions for a specified object. You can search for most recently used matches, for matching names, or for any match in a searchable field. You can also specify lookup filter bindings for dependent lookups.
